objects.name: Orbiting card — click to change color

origin.script: export function update(v){const t=engine.runtime*engine.userProperties.speed;return new Vec3(480+Math.cos(t)*120,270+Math.sin(t)*75,0);} export function cursorClick(){thisLayer.color=new Vec3(Math.random(),0.7,1);}

visible.script: let shape;export function init(){let data=thisScene.createModelData({vertexFormat:[IModelData.POSITION,IModelData.COLOR],vertexBuffer:[-35,-25,0,0.2,0.8,1,1,35,-25,0,0.9,0.3,0.6,1,0,40,0,1,0.8,0.2,1],indexBuffer:[0,1,2]});shape=thisScene.createLayer(data);shape.origin=new Vec3(480,110,0);return false;}export function update(){shape.angles=new Vec3(0,0,engine.runtime*45);return false;}
